description: This is an integration test script for verifying progressive backoff logic in AWS IoT SDK, involving multi-threaded MQTT client connections, simulated network failures, message exchange, and backoff timing verification.

classes.name: threadPool
classes.description: Manages MQTT publish/subscribe threads with simulated network failures and timing records.

methods.name: _messageCallback
methods.description: Callback for processing incoming MQTT messages.

methods.name: threadARuntime
methods.description: Publishes messages when the thread is signaled to do so.

methods.name: _publish3Messages
methods.description: Publishes three messages to the MQTT topic.

methods.name: threadBRuntime
methods.description: Handles subscription, simulates network failures, and records timing data.

methods.name: _manualNetworkError
methods.description: Simulates a network disconnection by closing socket connections.

methods.name: getReconnectTimeRecord
methods.description: Returns the list of recorded reconnect times.

methods.name: getConnectedTimeRecord
methods.description: Returns the list of connected periods.
